notes: This contract pins Umbra's official C++ Handle::encode foundation to the 2025 C++ helper rule: each helper emits its corresponding HLA<type>Handle data type from HLAstandardMIM. The standard MIM declares the ten handle data types as HLAvariableArray of HLAbyte; the companion 1516.2 contract pins that array's signed HLAinteger32BE element-count rule. Umbra deliberately uses one fixed eight-octet implementation-owned identity payload inside that required wrapper. This is source/test traceability only. It does not demonstrate interoperability with another RTI implementation, public service behavior, package/JUnit/protected-review evidence, or conformance.
